summary: Verified Resource Library feature end-to-end on DEMO-01. Backend (9/9 pytest passed): resources CRUD (create character/background, upload image via /canvas/media + PATCH media_id, delete), invalid kind rejection, POST /resources/auto-map (ai_used=true, 11 scenes updated, background 'Quán cà phê' assigned to S1 cafe scene), scene PATCH persistence for characters/background_id/design_note with rev, POST /canvas/build-scenes creates frame nodes (title '<code> · <title>'), and per-scene canvas ?scene_id= is fully INDEPENDENT from project canvas (saving scene canvas does not change project canvas rev nor nodes). Frontend UI: login → /projects/{id}/resources loads resources-page with 11 scene rows, Nhân vật + Bối cảnh columns; added TEST_An_UI character via add-character-input/btn (card resource-<id> rendered), deleted it via resource-delete-<id> (card removed); S1 scene-bg select shows 'Quán cà phê' (auto-map result); design_note persisted after page reload; scene-open-canvas-<id> navigates to /projects/{id}/scenes/{sid}/canvas, scene-canvas-banner shows 'Canvas dự án / S1 · NỘI. QUÁN CÀ PHÊ - NGÀY' with link back; scene canvas rendered nodes (design_note comment + backend-added marker). No pageerror, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: resources.py auto_map uses model 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview' — verify EMERGENT_LLM_KEY supports that alias; falls back gracefully via substring match, which is currently the observed AI success path.
Resources.jsx nests <Textarea> and other inline controls inside the flex row — works but could be split into a SceneRow component for readability (file is ~256 lines, acceptable).

canvas.py build_scenes replaces the entire per-scene canvas nodes on every rebuild — this overwrites any manual edits users made in a scene canvas. Consider merging like it does for project frames (frame_by_ref) or warn user before overwrite.
resources.py DELETE unlinks from scenes but does NOT bump scene rev — subsequent PATCH from cached UI with the old rev could still 409; UI reloads after delete so acceptable in practice.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_An_UI character; created TEST_BG_* background (deleted); added TEST_MARKER text node to S1's scene canvas (still present, harmless); set S1 design_note='TEST NOTE 86fa8'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: S1 scene canvas currently contains a TEST_MARKER node from independence-test; clean via API PUT if needed. Scene canvas 'Đã lưu' save button is disabled when nothing dirty — expected; make canvas 'dirty' first (e.g., drag a node) before asserting canvas-save-btn click. Auto-map on DEMO-01 assigns background 'Quán cà phê' to S1 by location/name substring; characters may be 0 for demo scenes since names don't appear literally. build-scenes overwrites per-scene canvases on each run.
